220000.description:
Elizabeth, a villainess whose poor social skills kept her from escaping condemnation, is chosen as a sacrifice to the Demon King. On the verge of being eaten, she shouts out the dream she couldn't fulfill in her previous life, becoming a chef: "Eat my cooking!" In the Demon King's castle, where not a single crop will grow, she is assigned to an "employee cafeteria" on the brink of closing! She resolves to win over the stomachs of the inscrutable Demon King and the fearsome demons with knowledge from her past life and warm food. But just when things seem to be going well, radicals who hate humans stand in her way...?

A demon-world gourmet fantasy in which a socially awkward young lady devoted to cooking starts a revolution through the stomach!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

title.native: 魔王城の絶品社食、作っているのは生贄です！@COMIC
title.romaji: Maou-jou no Zeppin Shashoku, Tsukutte Iru no wa Ikenie desu! @COMIC

220001.description:
The year is 20xx. The Japanese government, struggling with labor shortages, creates highly intelligent life forms called "Cobitons." A pilot program begins in City S, using them as labor replacements and family members. The Cobitons function smoothly and prove useful to the people. However, an unprecedented earthquake strikes the region, rendering them uncontrollable. They begin to run amok, unleashing a horrific slaughter. In this desperate situation, college student Jinya rises up to fight for survival! A groundbreaking survival suspense story!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220002.description:
"I finally managed to get it all the way in!" In a world where beastfolk and humans coexist peacefully, Hinako is a human woman married to the aloof wolfman Soshiro through an arranged marriage. Unsure how to bridge the distance between them, she takes a bold step and applies for "mating leave," paid time off meant to accommodate a beastfolk's mating period. Summoning all her courage, she tells Soshiro that she wants to spend a passionate night in his arms. In response, he bares the fangs he had always kept hidden and says, "I've been holding back all this time, so you'd better prepare yourself." With that, he unleashes a fiery passion beyond anything she had ever dreamed of. "No way, it's getting even bigger!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Mating Leave: My Beastman Husband's Insatiable Rut
title.native: 交配休暇~獣人夫の本気の発情が止まらない
title.romaji: Kouhai Kyuuka: Juujin Otto no Honki no Hatsujou ga Tomaranai

220003.description:
Toa was reincarnated as the second son of a noble family while retaining memories of his life on Earth. Although he aimed for a leisurely and comfortable life in another world, he was exiled to a border fort at a young age due to his lack of talent in swordsmanship and magic. Ten years later, following his father’s death, he was called back only to be disowned by his older brother, Grass, who had inherited the family. Undaunted by these harsh circumstances, Toa decided to use the skills and knowledge he acquired at the border fort to become an adventurer. However, after helping a girl named Nikka during the guild’s entrance exam, he becomes entangled in an incident that shakes the royal capital–!? The exhilarating battle fantasy begins, where those who underestimate him will pay double!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 放逐された転生貴族は、自由にやらせてもらいます
title.romaji: Houchiku Sareta Tensei Kizoku wa, Jiyuu ni Yarasete Moraimasu

220005.description:
Despite his tough-guy appearance, Spinel is a rough-and-tumble man who absolutely loves "cute things." Having been imprisoned for certain reasons, he decides to start a new life surrounded by "cute things" upon his release. Together with a fluffy beast he meets in town and a girl from the legendary "Celestial Race," he plans to run a cute "Fluffy Cafe" in his second life—or so he thought, but hard-hitting troubles keep piling up in his lap...!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)
